decisions.name: Words per caption page
decisions.rationale: 2 to 3 words per page reads at speech pace on a phone; more becomes subtitles.

decisions.name: Clean talking-head preset
decisions.rationale: White, soft shadow, no animation: the least distracting default for a person on camera.

decisions.name: Pop-in preset
decisions.rationale: Energetic formats tolerate animated captions; talking heads mostly do not.

decisions.name: Karaoke highlight preset
decisions.rationale: Word-level highlight helps retention when the narration is dense.

decisions.name: Emphasis color on numbers and keywords
decisions.rationale: Numbers and the script's emphasis_words carry the claim; color them, nothing else.

decisions.name: Emoji accents
decisions.rationale: One emoji per page at most; off for professional brands (brand kit decides).

decisions.name: Shift captions off the face
decisions.rationale: Rule F4: captions never cover the face; shift within universal_relaxed, else fewer lines, else hide.

decisions.name: Hide captions during on-screen text
decisions.rationale: Two text blocks at once halves reading speed (rule L2, S2).

decisions.name: Sidecar captions for long-form
decisions.rationale: YouTube long-form viewers toggle captions; burned-in text fights the player UI.

decisions.name: Minimum page display time
decisions.rationale: Pages shorter than about 350 ms flicker; merge them with the neighbour.
